scope: Ten circuit reference views and five era representative cars; limited photo-guided corrections, not full surveyed rebuilds.

references.author: United Autosports
references.description: Le circuit de Spa-Francorchamps 4 Heures de Spa-Francorchamps 2022
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: La Source/pit straight context and red/yellow Spa kerbs; the supplied image-8 is a game view, not a surveyed photograph.
references.implemented: Broader paved La Source outer apron; separate short apex/exit kerbs and recent red/yellow exits.
references.limits: Road centreline and legal white-line width unchanged; exact pit-island geometry and lettering remain approximate.

references.author: crash71100
references.description: Circuit de Monaco - Virage de la Piscine
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Piscine is constrained harbour-side asphalt with Armco and close quay facilities.
references.implemented: Reviewed and retained the previous mapped pool/quay/stand reconstruction.
references.limits: 2022 off-session photo does not establish race-day barrier placement; no new barrier offset claimed.

references.author: Luca Barni
references.description: Adrian Sutil alla prima variante Monza 2011
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Rettifilo uses alternating right/left apex kerbs, red/white paint and green adjacent paving.
references.implemented: Split recent first/second apex and exit kerbs; added green exit apron.
references.limits: 2011 view is not a survey of later resurfacing or sausage dimensions.

references.author: John Chapman
references.description: A Dempsey-Proton Racing-entered Porsche 911 RSR (number 88, being driven by Italian driver Gianluca Roda) leads the Aston Martin Racing Vantage GTE (number 98) out of Vale and into Club corner, during the 2018 6 Hours of Silverstone race. The Aston Martin had the last laugh at the finish, however, as it finished fourth in the LMGTE Am class, one lap ahead of the Porsche in eighth.
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Vale/Club has separate left/right kerbs and a green painted escape strip.
references.implemented: Split recent Vale/Club apex and exit windows; green Vale apron.
references.limits: Photo is 2018; dimensions and later-year paint changes are not certified.

references.author: Tokumeigakarinoaoshima
references.description: 鈴鹿サーキットにおける日立オートモーティブシステムズシケインから最終コーナーにかけての部分を撮影。
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Chicane-to-final-corner view shows grass islands, fencing and large stand banks.
references.implemented: Reviewed; existing mapped grass/gravel/stand arrangement retained.
references.limits: One 2017 view does not establish all chicane extents or newer resurfacing.

references.author: Audi do Brasil
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Senna S has left/right apices, green/yellow kerbs and green painted runoff.
references.implemented: Split recent Senna S kerbs; green/yellow palette and green apron.
references.limits: 2024 view guides the latest substitute, not the exact 2021 or 2023 race configuration.

references.author: by Grantuking
references.description: Dino ed Enzo Ferrari Circuit in Imola, Italy
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Trees enclose the track and discrete gravel areas; not continuous gravel everywhere.
references.implemented: Reviewed; existing mapped tree/gravel distribution retained.
references.limits: 2008 photo lacks calibrated coordinates; no new Rivazza geometry claim.

references.author: No machine-readable author provided. AndyMcG assumed (based on copyright claims).
references.description: Das ist ein Panoramafoto vom 2002 neu erbauten ersten Streckenteil des Nürburgrings. Die alte Schikane wurde zu einem engen Infield, der Mercedes-Arena, umgebaut. Allerdings kann eine Schikane, zwar in etwas verändeter Form, auch heute noch gefahren werden. Die Mercede-Arena ist die erste Streckenpassage nach der Start-/Zielgeraden.
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Mercedes Arena is broad paved infield with grass islands and distant stands.
references.implemented: Reviewed; existing recent asphalt runoff and mapped stands retained.
references.limits: Panorama is old and does not justify moving current mapped buildings.

references.author: Maela Ohana
references.description: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, Montreal, on a sunny summer day. Venue for the FIA Formula One Canadian Grand Prix. Cyclists in Montreal. Notre Dame Island. Parc Jean Drapeau. Black and White vintage style film photography
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Pit/start area is narrow, walled and bounded by stands rather than broad gravel.
references.implemented: Reviewed; retained mapped pit/wall/stand arrangement and constrained escape areas.
references.limits: 2016 black/white photo cannot establish kerb paint; island course did not exist in 1967.

references.author: Steffen Prößdorf
references.description: Motorsport, Porsche Carrera Cup Deutschland, Hockenheimring 2023: Harri Jones (AUS) mit einem Dreher an der Spitzkehre
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Spitzkehre foreground kerb is blue/white, not the generic red/white.
references.implemented: Corrected recent Spitzkehre palette and shortened its apex kerb.
references.limits: Only this hairpin is repainted; no new forest-course reconstruction.

references.author: RudiBellini
references.description: Lotus 49 da temporada de 1967 com o inovador motor Ford Cosworth V8.
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Restored Lotus 49 reference: front tyres smaller than rear; cigar body, narrow tread and dark helmet.
references.implemented: Axle-specific tyre radii shared with contact model; dark Lotus helmet.
references.limits: Restoration photographed in 2021, not a 1967 race; shared chassis, not exact every-constructor geometry.

references.author: Bahnfrend
references.description: A 1988 McLaren-Honda MP4/4, on display at the Goodwood Festival of Speed
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: MP4/4: low cowl, white slab sidepods with red upper/rear chevron; open small rims.
references.implemented: Narrower track, 0.33 m tyre radius, lower sidepods/wing/helmet; white McLaren pods, readable conformal lettering.
references.limits: Museum car photographed in 2009. Shared era proportions and approximate brand typography.

references.author: Rick Dikeman
references.description: Michael Schumacher, United States Grand Prix, Indianapolis, 2004
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: F2004 race photo: narrower car, high nose, white wing panels, pinched pods and grooved tyres.
references.implemented: Narrower wheel track/tread, 3.05 m wheelbase, smaller tyres/wings; revised Ferrari panels/helmet and conformal sidepod text.
references.limits: Other 2004 constructors inherit the shared-era geometric estimate, not Ferrari-specific CAD.

references.author: Lukas Raich
references.changes: Resized to fit 960 × 640 and JPEG-recompressed; no retouching. Reference only, never a game texture.
references.observation: Actual RB19 race photograph, not a showcar: low rear wing, wheel covers and dark driver helmet.
references.implemented: Lower rear-wing assembly, dark Verstappen helmet; spin/steering decoupled.
references.limits: Not an exact RB19 surface scan; other teams retain estimated variants.

references.title: FIA F1 Austria 2021 Nr. 33 Verstappen (side).jpg
references.author: Lukas Raich
references.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail resized to fit 960x640, JPEG recompressed; no retouching.
references.notes: 2021 Austrian Grand Prix side view; photographed driver and race number preserved in new roster. Photo is comparison/reference only, never a car texture.
references.observation: Actual Austrian GP RB16B: conventional narrow rear wing and open 13-inch rims.
references.implemented: Rear wing reduced to an estimated 0.95 m top; all ten 2021 liveries/variants retained; separated wheel steering and spin.
references.limits: Full partner marks and fine aero remain approximate; no extra exact team chassis.
